notes: script delta without the anchor majority
blocks.first_removed: Other than that, it borrows elements from [[[theme:penumbra-bhl|Penumbra BHL]]], [[[theme:ad-abyssum|Ad Abyssum Theme]]], [[[theme:placestyle|PLACESTYLE CSS]]] and [[[theme:flopstyle-dark|Flopstyle: DARK]]]; by [http://www.wikidot.com/user:info/estrellayoshte EstrellaYoshte], [http://www.wikidot.com/user:info/yossipossi Yossipossi], [http://www.wikidot.com/user:info/placeholder-mcd Placeholder McD] and [http://www.wikidot.com/user:info/lt-flops Lt Flops], respectively.
